_note: Inputs of route-actions, read only. Paths are relative to the repository root. The route files cite them.

notApplicable._note: Rules of section 3 (user delegation 2026-11-05, migration/clarify/auto-decisions-2026-11-05.md). A missing TST call whose every chain passes through `step` (a label of the chain), or whose every chain roots in a client action of the route's own files (`rootKinds`), is not a gap of the web app. Each rule cites its evidence; the route file prints it.

rules.title: Native only
rules.reason: TST offers the external share options only when AppManager_GetIsNative is true; the React app is never native.
rules.evidence: ShareSheet Action_SetExternalShareOptions appends Share via, Copy link, WhatsApp, Signal and Outlook inside `if (AppManager_GetIsNative)` (UBTConnect_Utils.CW_Share.ShareSheet.mvc.js:2418-2475); SharePopup appends "Share to other apps" after AppManager_GetIsNative (UBTConnect_Utils.CW_CTA_PopUps.SharePopup.mvc.js:274-288); ShareEntity_ByURL calls the SocialSharing plugin (UBTConnect_Utils.controller.js:5319+); app/src/platform/session/clientVars.ts:40 (DeviceInfo_IsNative false).

rules.title: Telemetry (decision U17)
rules.reason: The call belongs to the application-event pipeline (zOnApplicationEvent_Wrapper → getAppEventName → cacheLocalApplicationEvents). Telemetry is not wired in the mock phase (decision U17).
rules.evidence: Connect2_LegacyShared.controller.js:989-1240 (CacheLocalApplicationEvents); migration/app-shell.spec.md:349,384 (U17: no telemetry in the mock phase); app/src/lib/orbit/actions.ts:318-321.

rules.title: Decided earlier (Login Q3 a)
rules.reason: The device-awareness dialog comes with the production identity provider; DeviceAwareness_Use is false on TST.

rules.title: Unreachable on TST
rules.reason: The handler is bound only in the Month, Day and Agenda calendar views, and OnReady calls GetEventCalendarData only when CurrentEventView is not MyTimeline. The variable keeps its default MyTimeline: no action assigns it.
rules.evidence: Connect2_OrbitMobile_MUI.LDM_ScreenBlocks_V2.ScreenBlock_MyEvents_V2.mvc.js:50 (CurrentEventView default), :521-692 (the $if of the calendar views), :2140-2185 (OnReady: Day or Month? / MyTimeline? / else GetEventCalendarData), no `currentEventViewVar =` in the file; app/src/pages/LDM_MyEvents_V2/hooks/ldmMyEventsState.ts:16-18.

rules.title: No binding in the TST view
rules.reason: Every chain roots in a client action of the screen or of a block of its UI flow. No view event, lifecycle event or block event binds that action.
rules.evidence: facts.json callSites rootKinds of the call (the call graph of the compiled code, tools/os_call_graph.py).

rules.title: Declared, never fetched
rules.reason: The data action or aggregate fetches on demand (dataFetchDependenciesOriginal -1) and no action of the compiled code refreshes it: TST never calls it.
rules.evidence: facts.json callSites: the only chain is the synthetic 'fetch at start' root of the call graph; the fetch mode of the compiled file (tools/os_extras.py fetch_modes).
